subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Sacred One
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Sacred One.

hook.text: Monotheism's central claim: there is one God. Judaism, Christianity, and Islam all insist on this number.

buildup.text: The Shema declares: 'Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.' One is the core of faith.

discovery.text: In Neoplatonic philosophy, The One is the source of all existence—beyond even God. Unity precedes everything.

twist.text: Hinduism appears polytheistic but claims Brahman is the One underlying all gods. One hides inside many.

climax.text: One is the number that refuses division. It represents unity, origin, and the indivisible truth behind reality.

quiz.question: What does Brahman represent in Hinduism?
options: The one reality underlying all gods
